examples.trans: This is an old children's book.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: ironic: такая интересная = look at her, how convenient
ironic: такая интересная = look at her, how convenient

examples.trans: This is a very interesting book.

examples.text: Такая интересная. Я тебе не бандит.
examples.trans: Funny you should say that. I'm no gangster for you.

meanings.note: Я тебя не интересую = you're not interested in me

examples.text: Вспомнил? Я давно тебя не интересую.
examples.trans: Now you remember? You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

examples.text: Утром я обычно ем овсяную кашу.
examples.trans: In the morning I usually eat oatmeal porridge.

examples.text: Я пойду попробую приготовить себе кашу.
examples.trans: I will go try to cook myself some porridge.

examples.text: В тесте не должно быть комочков.
examples.trans: There should be no lumps in the batter.
Stir evenly, so there are no lumps.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

уже месяц = for a month now

examples.trans: I've been living here for a month.

examples.trans: Pasha and I have been together for a month now.

meanings.en: to hug, to put one's arms around
meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to hug, to embrace', paired with 'обнимать'.

examples.text: Юля, ну иди сюда, не обижайся! Иди обниму!
examples.trans: Yulia, come here, don't be upset! Come let me hug you!
The father hugged his daughter tightly.

examples.trans: I'm walking already! Right now through the park and the bridge, and I'm home.

meanings.note: у меня сердце = I have a bad heart (colloquial)

examples.text: Мне горько, мне плохо. У меня сердце.
examples.trans: I feel bitter, I feel awful. I have a bad heart.

meanings.en: strong, powerful (also used as a noun: the strong)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ильный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('strong, powerful').

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.
A strong wind was blowing outside.

examples.text: Надо заманить его на свою территорию. Там, где ты сильный.
examples.trans: You need to lure him onto your territory. Right where you are strong.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'прашивать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to ask', paired with 'спросить'.

examples.text: Вот это что такое, я вас спрашиваю!
examples.trans: What is this, I'm asking you!

examples.text: Ты у нас в клубе танцевала!
